diorama.settings.title: Map settings
diorama.settings.gpu_baking.tooltip: Experimental. Draws map tiles on the graphics card instead of the processor, so they appear sooner and the game uses less CPU. The first tiles are also drawn the old way and compared; if your graphics card draws them differently, it switches itself off.
diorama.gpu_baking.failed: GPU baking didn't match on this graphics card, so Diorama is drawing the map on the processor again. The game log has the details.
diorama.settings.minimap_shown.tooltip: Shows the minimap in a corner of the screen.
diorama.settings.compass.tooltip: Puts N, S, W and E on the minimap's edges. The map always faces north.
diorama.settings.coordinates.tooltip: Shows your block coordinates under the minimap.
diorama.settings.biome.tooltip: Shows the biome you're in under the minimap.
diorama.settings.auto_caves.tooltip: When you're underground, the minimap shows the cave you're in instead of the surface above.
diorama.settings.corner.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the minimap sits in.
diorama.settings.size.tooltip: How wide the minimap is. It shrinks to fit a small screen.
diorama.settings.zoom.tooltip: How close the minimap is zoomed in. The zoom keys change it too.
diorama.settings.players.tooltip: Shows other players on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.hostile.tooltip: Shows monsters, like zombies and creepers, on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.neutral.tooltip: Shows mobs that only attack when provoked, like wolves, bees and endermen, on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.passive.tooltip: Shows animals, villagers and other harmless mobs on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.range.tooltip: Players and mobs farther above or below you than this are left off the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.chunk_grid.tooltip: Draws chunk borders on the map.
diorama.settings.slime_chunks.tooltip: Marks the chunks where slimes spawn on the map. Single player only, in the Overworld: it needs the world's seed.
diorama.settings.spawn_spots.tooltip: Marks blocks on the map where monsters can spawn: those dark even by day, or also those dark only at night.
diorama.settings.waypoints_map.tooltip: Shows your waypoints on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.waypoints_world.tooltip: Shows your waypoints in the world, with their distance, even through terrain.
diorama.settings.deaths.tooltip: Adds a waypoint where you die.
diorama.settings.outlines.tooltip: Darkens the edge where a block stands in front of lower ground, so cliffs and roofs stand out.
diorama.settings.rounded_fog.tooltip: Rounds off the edge of the explored map, instead of following the square edges of chunks.
diorama.settings.fog_of_war.tooltip: Cave maps show only the blocks you've seen, even where the server allows the full map.
diorama.settings.quality.tooltip: Fast fills in the map about four times sooner and draws simpler fog. For slower computers.
